<!-- Please read CONTRIBUTING.md / 提交前请阅读 CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md。
One PR, one independent goal. Related tests and docs belong in the same PR.
一个 PR 只处理一个独立目标，相关测试和文档可以一并提交。
-->

## Purpose / 目的

<!-- What single problem does this solve? Link a related issue if available.
这次只解决什么问题？有相关 Issue 时请附链接。
-->

## Changes / 修改范围

<!-- Summarize concrete changes. Move unrelated features or refactors to another PR.
列出具体修改；无关功能或重构请另开 PR。
-->

-

## Impact / 影响

<!-- Affected platforms, behavior and compatibility. Add screenshots for UI changes.
说明受影响的平台、行为和兼容性；界面修改请附截图。
If this depends on another PR, link it and explain the merge order.
如依赖其他 PR，请附链接并说明合并顺序。
-->

## Validation / 验证

<!-- List actual commands or manual steps and their results.
State relevant platforms not tested; documentation-only changes can use formatting/link checks.
填写实际执行的命令或手动步骤及结果，注明尚未验证的相关平台。
纯文档修改可以填写格式和链接检查结果。
-->

-

## Checklist / 提交前确认

- [ ] This PR has one independent goal. / 本 PR 只有一个独立目标。
- [ ] Unrelated changes are in separate PRs. / 无关改动已拆分。
- [ ] Relevant tests and docs are updated where needed. / 已按需补充相关测试和文档。
- [ ] Validation results and coverage limits are described above. / 已说明验证结果与未覆盖范围。
